page_title: ScaleReach.ai | Turn One Video Into Viral Shorts

sources.entry: ScaleReach - Turns long YouTube and other videos into 9:16 short clips with AI captions and face-tracking crop. #paid

summary.name: ScaleReach
summary.one_liner: ScaleReach is an AI video repurposing tool that turns long videos from YouTube, Twitch, Google Drive and other links, or uploaded files, into captioned 9:16 short clips for TikTok, Reels and Shorts.
use_cases: Turn a long podcast or YouTube video into short clips
Add word-by-word captions to vertical videos
Schedule clips to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, X and LinkedIn
Find the most engaging moments in a long recording
Generate clips by chatting with an AI assistant via MCP
summary.what_it_does: ScaleReach takes a video link (YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Google Drive, Dropbox, Loom, Rumble and others) or an uploaded MP4, MOV or WebM file, transcribes it, and scores moments for viral potential. It cuts the strongest moments into 9:16 clips with face-tracking reframing and word-by-word captions. Clips get auto-generated thumbnails and can be shared through public links. A built-in scheduler can post clips to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X and LinkedIn, and an MCP server lets MCP-compatible AI assistants generate clips and schedule posts.
notable: Viral score prediction and split-screen gameplay layout
Social scheduler included at every paid tier
MCP server for clipping and posting from AI assistants
Accepts many hosted video links, not just YouTube
caveats: Free plan adds a watermark and limits editing; watermark removal needs a paid plan
Processing length capped per file: 2 hours on Starter, 3 hours on Pro and Agency
Paid plans start at $10/month annual or $12/month monthly; the page also says the category listing is tagged #paid
